nodes.name: agent_org_watchdog.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the stalled-run watchdog: budget-limited recovery attempts, inspection of stalled agent org runs to build a StallRecoveryPlan (rewaking members, reassigning ready tasks, coordinator repair), and applying that plan.
nodes.languageNotes: inspect_stalled_run is a large (~330 line) decision function synthesizing task state, session status, and intervention state into a single recovery plan.

nodes.name: init_schema
nodes.summary: Creates the database table(s)/indexes for this module if they do not already exist (the stalled-run recovery watchdog).

nodes.name: budget_disposition
nodes.summary: Checks the recovery-attempt budget for a given (run, action, target) key and decides whether another recovery attempt is allowed.

nodes.name: record_attempt
nodes.summary: Records that a recovery attempt was made for a given key, incrementing its budget counter and fingerprint.

nodes.name: clear_rewake_budget
nodes.summary: Clears the rewake-attempt budget counter for a given run/member, e.g. after a successful rewake.

nodes.name: record_accepted_member_rewake
nodes.summary: Records that a member rewake attempt was accepted, updating its recovery-budget bookkeeping accordingly.

nodes.name: test_only_mark_failed_rewake_attempt
nodes.summary: Test-only helper that marks a member's rewake attempt as failed to exercise budget-exhaustion recovery paths.

nodes.name: is_noop
nodes.summary: Checks whether is noop (the stalled-run recovery watchdog).

nodes.name: ready_unassigned_repair_reason
nodes.summary: Determines the repair reason string to report when a ready-but-unassigned task is found during stall inspection.

nodes.name: spawn
nodes.summary: Spawns the background watchdog loop that periodically scans for and recovers stalled agent org runs.

nodes.name: prune_recovery_budgets
nodes.summary: Removes expired recovery-budget rows to prevent unbounded growth of the watchdog bookkeeping table.

nodes.name: recover_stalled_run
nodes.summary: Inspects a stalled run to build a recovery plan and applies it (rewaking members, reassigning tasks, notifying the coordinator).

nodes.name: inspect_stalled_run
nodes.summary: Large decision function that inspects a run's tasks, member sessions, and interventions to synthesize a StallRecoveryPlan describing which members to wake, which tasks to reassign, and whether coordinator repair is needed.

nodes.name: is_quiescent_completed_run_status
nodes.summary: Checks whether is quiescent completed run status (the stalled-run recovery watchdog).

nodes.name: is_wakeable_status
nodes.summary: Checks whether is wakeable status (the stalled-run recovery watchdog).

nodes.name: is_stale_in_progress
nodes.summary: Determines whether an in-progress task is 'stale' by comparing its update timestamp against the owning session's last activity.

nodes.name: insert_coordinator_stall_notice
nodes.summary: Inserts an inbox notice to the coordinator explaining why a run needed stall-recovery intervention.

nodes.name: StallRecoveryPlan
nodes.summary: The output of stall inspection: which members to wake, which task continuation/assignment actions to take, and any coordinator repair needed.

nodes.name: MemberContinuationAction
nodes.summary: Data record with fields: member_id, recipient_agent_id, task_ids (the stalled-run recovery watchdog).

nodes.name: MemberTaskAssignmentAction
nodes.summary: Data record with fields: member_id, recipient_agent_id, task_ids (the stalled-run recovery watchdog).

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting all coordination submodules (inbox, interventions, plan approvals, runs, tasks, watchdog, schedulers) that implement the multi-agent org coordination subsystem.

nodes.name: routine_scheduler.rs
nodes.summary: Background scheduler that evaluates recurring 'routine' triggers (cron-like) against catch-up policy and fires due routines to spawn new agent org runs.

nodes.name: spawn
nodes.summary: Spawns the background loop that periodically ticks the routine scheduler.

nodes.name: debug_run_once
nodes.summary: Debug/test entry point that runs a single scheduler tick immediately rather than waiting for the interval loop.

nodes.name: tick
nodes.summary: Single scheduler tick: evaluates all active routines against the current time and fires any that are due.

nodes.name: evaluate_routine
nodes.summary: Evaluates a single routine's trigger against the current time, applying catch-up policy to compute which occurrences should fire.

nodes.name: fire
nodes.summary: Fires a routine at a scheduled time, spawning a new agent org run for it.

nodes.name: due_times
nodes.summary: Computes the set of due trigger times for a routine within a given time window.

nodes.name: apply_catch_up_policy
nodes.summary: Limits the number of missed occurrences that should be caught up on, based on the routine's catch-up policy and a max-runs cap.

nodes.name: next_occurrence
nodes.summary: Computes the next scheduled occurrence time for a routine trigger after a given time.

nodes.name: work_item_recovery.rs
nodes.summary: Startup recovery routine that marks any work items left in an interrupted state (from a previous crash/shutdown) back to a resumable state.

nodes.name: mark_all_interrupted_sync
nodes.summary: Synchronously marks all work items left in an interrupted state (from an unclean previous shutdown) back to a resumable state, run at application startup.
